name: Chijoru Mama o Meshiagare ~Futaritabi~
original_name: 痴女るママをめしあがれ～ふたり旅～
source:
Two slutty young wives, “Ran Shirayuki” and “Shion Himeno,” leave the mainland to take a trip to a remote island…

Taking advantage of this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, these two nymphomaniac wives let loose with all sorts of sexual desires…

Just what kind of trip will this turn out to be?
